title: A launch called ready had 1 of 14 campaigns graded
hypothesis: The launch was ready apart from the footer address.
change: Graded every draft through all five gates and checked the pre-send receipt (gtme ready, b74c7371).
result: The live drafts graded 25 to 67 against the 85 bar, 1 of 14 campaigns had been graded, gates 3 to 5 were NOT CHECKED, 104 of 746 firm names carried legal suffixes like L.P., and the pre-send receipt had expired.
next_decision: Report gtme ready's NOT READY list as it stands; ready-guard refuses a readiness claim without a signed READY under 2 hours old.
check: Never call a launch ready until gtme ready prints READY; a gate that is NOT CHECKED counts as a blocker.
scope: Any campaign launch, resume or add-leads.
